title: Spec 015 Tenant current-main audit and authority convergence evidence

phases.objective: Validate historical portfolio/candidate evidence, exact-current-main field-level reuse, canonical semantic ownership, and a decision-ready but unapproved T006 cutover register without reconstructing candidates, creating duplicate persistence, or granting runtime authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec 015 audit regression and canonical authority convergence validator from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Historical evidence remains immutable; the current-main matrix is anchored to 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878; T002/T003 evidence is complete; seven T006 cutover decisions are machine-readable and pending owner approval; T006/T008 stay open; no runtime, migration, provider, permission, persistence, or Production authority is granted.
steps: Validate the immutable 2026-08-12 portfolio/candidate audit and its own historical snapshot SHA.
Validate the additive 2026-09-06 current-main authority matrix and every field-level disposition.
Validate canonical concepts separate Business Action, Provider Capability Group, Operation, Tool, Package, context, execution and projection semantics.
Validate current package/version/install/capability/Activity Pack/System Tool Catalog authorities are reused or explicitly classified as compatibility/projection inputs.
Validate the T006 decision register classifies numeric Spec 011/014, the System Tool Catalog cluster, legacy actions, capability authority transition, package reuse, and external protocol boundaries.
Verify the T006 register is decision-ready but approval_status remains pending_owner_review and cutover_executed=false.
Verify canonical_capabilities is a semantic target while global runtime cutover still requires shadow parity because legacy action/tool registries remain part of current execution authority.
Verify T002/T003 are evidence-complete and T006/T008 remain unchecked.
Run Spec 015 contract and E2E validators without database, provider, Cloudflare, migration, or Production access.
assertions: Historical candidate evidence and the newer current-main authority inventory remain distinct evidence artifacts.
No wholesale solution_package_* persistence, new execution authority, or new permission authority is approved.
The legacy actions table is semantically a Provider Capability Group authority, not a Business Action authority.
The legacy actions/endpoints keys remain compatibility identifiers; no physical rename is authorized.
canonical_capabilities cannot be declared globally cut over from table existence alone; shadow parity and rollback proof remain required.
Tool visibility, Packages, Skills, Agents, Installation Revisions, Execution Capsules, Effective Runtime Manifests, and external protocols cannot independently grant execution authority.
No database migration, provider write, Production mutation, candidate merge, or secret access is executed.
